get_torch_optimizers: get a list of all available PyTorch optimizer names from torch.optim
create_optimizer_config_class: dynamically create a wrapper config class for a PyTorch optimizer using make_config_class
create_optimizer_union_default: create a default Optimizer__Union instance that uses Adam as the default optimizer
make_optimizer_scheduler: build an optimizer scheduler from an Optimizer__Union instance by passing model parameters
review_optimizer_classes_dict: review the classes dictionary mapping optimizer names to their dynamically generated config subclasses
